name: Ksenia Klokova
evidence: Co-author of 'Cultural Evaluation of LLMs in Russian: Catchphrases and Cultural Types' (Dialogue 2025, https://dialogue-conf.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/GromenkoEetal.029.pdf). The proceedings PDF is the only plausible printed source and dialogue-conf.org is egress-blocked in this container (curl -> CONNECT 403); a WebSearch over the paper plus her surname surfaced no address. GitHub code search for '"Klokova" "@" in:file' returned only unrelated namesakes (Nadiia Klokova of DeepFloyd, Katia Moklokova of Electron, credential-dump and password-list files) with no tie to Russian linguistics or LLM evaluation, so the namesake rule rules them all out.
